scenarios.name: Opening settings never downloads or enables an optional model
scenarios.given: optional model files already exist but the user has not enabled multilingual History search
scenarios.then: the model is offered without download or activation; only an explicit switch enables it

scenarios.name: Explicit download activates only verified files
scenarios.then: existing search remains available during download and the option activates only after verified completion

scenarios.name: Cancel ignores a late download completion
scenarios.given: a model download is in progress
scenarios.when: the user cancels and the service completes late
scenarios.then: the model stays disabled without late progress or activation

scenarios.name: Remove immediately revokes optional search
scenarios.then: optional search is disabled before file removal completes and existing conversations remain outside that operation

scenarios.name: Phone and tablet Settings expose real download and removal controls
scenarios.given: a simulator with synthetic absent or installed assets and the production Settings view
scenarios.when: the user opens Settings, downloads and cancels, or opts in and removes the installed model
scenarios.then: opening Settings never starts download, incomplete files cannot be enabled, the enable switch cannot activate the adjacent Remove button, and Cancel and Remove return to the downloadable disabled state
